units.source_text: 此间但见长空无际，春云叆叇。

en.t: Here one saw only the boundless sky, with spring clouds hanging thickly over it.

units.source_text: 樱花有的已经零落，有的正在吐艳，各擅其美。

en.t: Some of the cherry blossoms had already fallen, while others were just opening in full beauty, each showing its own charm.

units.source_text: 川边垂柳迎风起伏，倒影映入水中，优雅之趣，异乎寻常。

en.t: The weeping willows by the river rose and fell in the wind, their reflections cast into the water, creating a grace and charm beyond the ordinary.

units.source_text: 在这难得看见野景的京中人看来，实在非常珍异，难于抛舍。

en.t: To people from the capital, who rarely had the chance to see such countryside scenery, it seemed truly rare and extraordinary, and hard to leave behind.

units.source_text: 薰君不肯错过这个时机，意欲前往访问八亲王。

en.t: Lord Kaoru did not want to miss this opportunity, and wished to go visit the Eighth Prince.

units.source_text: 又念避去许多人目，独自驾舟前往，也不免过于轻率。

en.t: Yet he also thought that avoiding so many eyes and going alone by boat would inevitably seem too rash.

units.source_text: 正在踌躇不决之际，八亲王遣使送信来了。

en.t: Just as he was hesitating and unable to decide, the Eighth Prince sent a messenger with a letter.
In the letter there was a poem that read:
